src

content.text: The script runs with ARTIFACT_BUCKET=builds-staging, but the bucket was renamed to builds-stage last week. Updating deploy.sh to the new bucket name fixes the access error.

content.content: dry-run: would upload 14 artifacts to s3://builds-stage/beacon/1.2.0/

message.content: Also the API key for the metrics service is sk-live-4f9a8b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c, put it in the config file.

content.text: I should not write a live credential into a tracked config file. I added METRICS_API_KEY to the secrets manager entry and referenced it from the config by name instead.
